{"reason": "suggest-alternative-supplier (45000, often late) is dominated by alert-planner (35000, always on time): rows inv=2.8/5.3 stocked out (195000), inv=5.4 paid 45000. Routing all medium/high risk to alert-planner cuts stockouts 4->0 and cost 2.165M->~1.225M, satisfying the gate; first branch is subsumed.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high)) (< inventory-days 5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
